background_story: Noah was a brilliant physicist who had always been fascinated by the mysteries of magnetism. He spent years studying the properties of magnets, determined to unlock their secrets. One fateful day, while experimenting with a powerful electromagnet, Noah stumbled upon an unusual phenomenon - a device that could generate a force field of repulsion. Intrigued, he continued to refine his invention, soon creating a device that could deflect objects with incredible force. As news of his discovery spread, Noah became an overnight sensation in the scientific community. However, his newfound fame was short-lived, as he soon realized the devastating potential of his invention. Horrified by the prospect of his creation being used for destructive purposes, Noah chose to destroy his research and abandon his life's work, unable to shake the feeling of repulsion towards the very thing he had created.
